def equation(t, P, params):
    w = params[0]
    s1 = np.sin(w*t); c1 = np.cos(w*t)
    s2 = np.sin(2*w*t); c2 = np.cos(2*w*t)
    return (params[1] + params[2]*P + params[3]*P**2 + params[4]*P**3
            + (params[5] + params[6]*P)*s1 + params[7]*c1
            + params[8]*s2 + params[9]*c2)
